title: Genius Doronbow
gist: The gang's own anthem. They brag about their sharp minds and great ideas, swear they will have the Skull Stone, and shrug off every defeat.

title: The Yatterman Song
gist: Siren wailing, Yatterwan races around the globe, and the masked heroes' sense of justice sends the Doronbow flying.

title: Doronbow's Big Letdown
gist: The gang boast of being famous star villains, working hard at the same old routine. Then Dokurobey turns up as just a voice again, and the mood falls flat.

title: Yatter King
gist: The red-masked giant robot outruns wind and cloud to the ends of the earth to round up the Doronbow in one go.

title: Doronbow's Lament
gist: The gang blame Dokurobey's weird orders for the state they are in, then meekly get back to work and beg forgiveness.

title: The Zenderman Song
gist: Mysterious guardians of justice appear from a time tunnel with their lion mecha and race across sky, sea and time.

title: A Song for Dokurobey-sama
gist: Scarier than Mama: the trio beg for a gentle punishment, each moaning in turn, and taste the sourness of failure in tears at sunset.

title: The Rescueman Song
gist: A voice of justice calls from beyond the sky: Hikaru and Nana of the Time Patrol come to the rescue with seven mecha to protect history.

title: Odate-Buta
gist: Everyone gangs up to praise one pig. Flatter it enough and it gets ideas, and up the tree it goes.

title: The Yattodetaman Song
gist: A far-off flute plays the melody of justice. The hero crosses flowing time hunting the shining bird Jujaku, and with Koyomi calls the giant Daikyojin.

title: Pigs Fall from the Sky
gist: A string of old proverbs with every key word swapped for "pig", while pigs rain down from the sky.

title: Gyakuten! Ippatsuman
gist: Call and he comes flying across time, with wings faster than wind and a heart hotter than flame. He turns the tables, and evil shall not pass.

title: Ah! Gyakuten-O
gist: A solemn ode: justice lives in fearless hearts and courage shines brighter than stars. Run with open arms, for heaven and sea know your truth.

title: Itadaki Mambo
gist: A love-struck pick-up song whose lines pun on the names of 1980s pop idols, and whose hook is "I'll take it all!"

title: Time Bokan
gist: A countdown, then lift-off: the time machine zips between past, future, yesterday and today, and into unknown worlds.

title: 18 Villainous Years: Never Letting Go, Smooch!
gist: Eighteen years on, a tiny baby has grown into a big boy, but the trio are as bad as ever. Stepped on or beaten, they will never let you go.

title: The Villains' Door Opens
gist: A pile of puns on "aku" (evil). However loudly justice laughs, the villains rise again, and when the bad guys play, good kids learn.
